cached_image_boot.measurement: Three sequential fresh VMs cloned from the cached base image, measured from POST initiation to first startup-command output observed through Orchard events; no Nix/c2j/bootstrap. One-second event polling.
cached_image_boot.cleanup: All three exact VM API records removed and verified absent.

prepared_fresh_clones.method: Prepare one template, shut it down, then create three distinct Orchard VMs from its stopped worker-local Tart image. Each clone cold-boots and executes the normal provider startup/guest-runner path. No registry export/pull. One-second API event polling.
prepared_fresh_clones.readiness: The unprivileged process delivered through the normal guest runner successfully ran c2j version, pinged the Nix daemon, and wrote a unique readiness marker. All workers then completed successfully.
prepared_fresh_clones.freshness: Template was shut down before cloning; each sample had a distinct Orchard VM UID and macOS boot-session UUID. Prepared-profile cache hit verified in every clone.
prepared_fresh_clones.cleanup: All three clones and the template were deleted; API-record absence verified.
prepared_fresh_clones.limitations: Worker-local prepared template; no OCI registry export/import. Polling resolution approximately one second. Measures worker readiness, not a leased job completion.

prepared_suspended_clones.method: Prepare one unused template, suspend it, then create three sequential distinct Orchard VMs from its worker-local saved state. Verify preserved boot UUID and process nonce/PID. Execute normal bootstrap/guest-runner path and c2j/Nix readiness probe. One-second event polling.
prepared_suspended_clones.readiness: Unprivileged supplied process ran c2j version, pinged the Nix daemon and wrote a unique marker. All three workers completed successfully and shut down.
prepared_suspended_clones.freshness: Three distinct VM UIDs; each resumed the untouched template boot UUID and resident canary nonce/PID. Prepared-environment cache hit verified.
prepared_suspended_clones.cleanup: Template and all three clones deleted; API-record absence verified.
prepared_suspended_clones.limitations: Template preparation/suspension excluded from readiness timing. Worker-local snapshot, one sequential clone at a time; no registry memory-state transfer. About one-second polling resolution. No leased job exercised. Historical cold-boot comparison used the previous Orchard build; not remeasured after update. Production provider support remains disabled.
